rationale: The held 79 FR 42971 text confirms EO 13672 (2014-07-21) and its five sections. The held 90 FR 8633 text of EO 14173 section 3(a)(iii) revokes 'Executive Order 13672 of July 21, 2014' by name, with no delay; the 90-day window in 3(b)(i) applies only to the revocation of EO 11246, as the decision says. So every command of 13672 ended on 2025-01-21, and number searches found no earlier end. The decision honestly keeps open whether the wording it inserted survives in EO 11478, and it treats the U.S. Code and CFR pointers as leads only. That open question concerns EO 11478's text and does not undo the express revocation of 13672 itself.
